title: Buy now, pay later model's been better than traditional credit cards in downturns: Klarna CEO
summary: Bloomberg interview with Klarna's CEO defending BNPL's performance and growth strategy after a valuation reset.

assertions.quote: this model is so much better in a tougher economical environment than the traditional credit card model

verdicts.note: A company CEO's self-reported comparison of its own credit losses to the credit card industry, not independently verified.

assertions.quote: your average outstanding balance is $70, only outstanding for less than two months

verdicts.note: A company CEO's self-reported description of its own loan book, not independently verified.

assertions.quote: are you profitable here? No, we're not

verdicts.note: Affirm and Klarna have both posted large losses in various quarters despite high transaction volume, per their public financial disclosures.

assertions.quote: the tremendous amount of data that us as customers have decided to entrust them with

verdicts.note: Plausible and consistent with providers' own statements about using purchase data for marketing, though the full extent is hard to verify.
